plan: This is a sealed-bid second-price auction. With rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly above your true value. Given my value of $26, I will bid $26.1. This should maximize my chances of winning when my value is higher than the other bidders' bids, without overpaying.

This is a single-round auction. The optimal bidding strategy in a sealed-bid second-price auction is to bid truthfully. This is because bidding less than your value risks losing the auction when you could have won and made a profit, while bidding more than your value risks winning the auction and paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my true value.

I will use the Nash Equilibrium strategy. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid two-thirds of my value. My value is $24, so I will bid (2/3) * 24 = $16. This strategy assumes the other bidders are also rational and using a similar strategy.
